title: Big Bold Fruity Lemon Lime 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Big Bold Fruity Nic Salts Lemon Lime delivers a vibrant and tangy fusion of sharp lemon and refreshing lime. This classic citrus duo offers a perfectly balanced vape that’s bursting with zingy, zesty flavour, ideal for vapers who enjoy bold and invigorating fruit e-liquids. Formulated with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Big Bold Nic Salts are designed for use with mouth-to-lung (MTL) starter kits and pod devices. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, these nic salts provide smooth throat hits and rapid nicotine relief, making them ideal for recent ex-smokers or vapers looking for a fast, satisfying alternative to traditional tobacco products. If you love this flavour, there are several other flavours to try from Big Bold’s collection, including Menthols, Creamy and Fruity flavours. Explore such beguiling blends as Honey Melon, Banana Milk, and Vanilla Custard for a Big Bold burst of flavour and a taste sensation like no other.
